title: Real Estate Retargeting Ads: How to Win Back Buyers Who Didn't Enquire

faqs.question: What are retargeting ads in real estate?
faqs.answer: Ads shown again to people who already showed interest in your project, such as visiting your landing page, watching your video, opening your lead form or messaging you, but who did not book a site visit. Each group sees a new message that answers what stopped them the first time.

faqs.question: How do I retarget website visitors in real estate with ads?
faqs.answer: Install the Meta Pixel and Google tag on each project page, track floor plan views, price page views and form starts, build audiences from those, exclude people who already enquired or booked, and show each audience a new ad that answers what stopped them. Measure site visits in your CRM.

faqs.question: Which retargeting audiences should a real estate project build?
faqs.answer: Video viewers, Facebook and Instagram engagers, landing page visitors, floor plan or price page visitors, lead form openers who did not submit, and leads who have not visited yet. Build them by how close each person came to enquiring, and always exclude people who already booked.

faqs.question: How far back can Meta retarget website visitors?
faqs.answer: Meta's website custom audiences documentation lists a retention window of 1 to 180 days. Choose a window that matches your buying cycle, shorter for a launch and longer for slower ready-to-move decisions, and check the current limit in Ads Manager when you create the audience.

faqs.question: How long can Google Ads remarket to visitors?
faqs.answer: Google's data segments help page gives a default membership duration of 30 days and a maximum of 540 days. Pick a duration that suits how long buyers take to decide on your project, and exclude people who have already booked or enquired recently.

faqs.question: What should I show in real estate retargeting ads?
faqs.answer: Something new that answers the question that stopped them: a sample flat walkthrough for viewers, RERA and loan details for page visitors, specific units or a site visit invite for price page visitors, and an easier way to enquire for form openers.

faqs.question: How much budget do real estate retargeting ads need?
faqs.answer: Retargeting audiences are small, so they usually need only a modest share of the ad budget. Watch frequency and audience size, refresh the creative when frequency rises and results fall, and judge results by cost per site visit from your CRM, not only by cost per lead.

faqs.question: Do I need consent for retargeting in India?
faqs.answer: Tell visitors in your privacy policy that you use cookies and pixels for advertising, and upload customer lists only of people who agreed to hear from you, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Check current rules with your lawyer.

faqs.question: Can retargeting replace sales follow-up?
faqs.answer: No. Someone who submitted a form needs a call and a WhatsApp message first, ideally within minutes. Retargeting ads support follow-up by keeping the project in front of buyers between conversations; they do not replace the sales team, and they should never target people who asked you to stop.
